summary: 30-year-old Denver man took a 75-ft tumbling fall in The Trough area of Longs Peak; RMNP rangers provided initial care at 9:30 a.m.; Colorado National Guard helicopter (Buckley AFB) hoist extraction ~1:45 p.m. to Upper Beaver Meadows; ambulance to Estes Park Health; Rocky Mountain Rescue and Rocky Mountain Fire assisted
responding_agency: RMNP SAR (Colorado National Guard, Rocky Mountain Rescue, Rocky Mountain Fire assisted)
notes: Date from article text (Friday, July 12, 2019 — weekday-verified); fills thin year 2019 for Longs
